ios.NSUserNotificationsUsageDescription: We'd like to send you notifications to let you know when a letter arrives from your partner or a special day is coming up.
ios.NSCameraUsageDescription: We need access to your camera so you can add photos to your memories.
ios.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: We need access to your photo library so you can add photos to your memories.
ios.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Location access is needed so we can show your current location on the map when you choose a meeting point.
